name: sub-agent-compact
description: Separate auto-compact points for the main chat and for each sub-agent, keyed on the agent identity Claude Code's function hooks carry.

mainAutoCompact.title: Main chat auto-compact point
mainAutoCompact.description: Context tokens at which the main chat compacts: an integer or a k/m suffix ("600k", "0.6m").

subagentAutoCompact.title: Sub-agent auto-compact point
subagentAutoCompact.description: Context tokens at which a sub-agent compacts when its agent definition carries no autoCompact frontmatter: an integer or a k/m suffix.

agentDirs.title: Extra agent-definition directories
agentDirs.description: Comma-separated directories searched for agent definitions after <cwd>/.claude/agents and ~/.claude/agents.

logFile.title: Decision log file
logFile.description: Absolute path of a JSONL file that records every compaction decision; empty for none.
